title: alpha-AOS declared fact vocabulary
description: Closed-world contract for catalog/facts.yaml. Every fact a pack predicate may name is declared here, with one of six bounded detector kinds plus that kind's parameters. Detector kinds are code; detector instances are data, so adding a fact needs no TypeScript edit and no rebuild. Content-match vocabularies are declared here — in a repository-owned reviewed file — and are never taken from the scanned project.

facts.description: Every declared fact. A pack predicate naming a fact absent from this array is refused at load rather than being permanently unselectable.

^x-[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$.description: A namespaced extension. Preserved verbatim and inert; nothing in alpha-AOS reads it.

id.description: Stable fact identifier, referenced by pack predicates and by evidence records.

kind.description: Which of the six bounded detectors observes this fact. The enum is closed: a seventh kind is an additive schema change, never a silent extension.

packages.description: kind=dependency: package names to look for in a declared dependency manifest.

files.description: kind=file and kind=fileAbsent: the alternative paths, relative to the canonical root. kind=fileContent: the search set the declared patterns are applied to.

directories.description: kind=directory: the alternative directory paths, relative to the canonical root.

manifestKey.description: kind=manifestKey: the project-manifest key that carries this fact. Only a current, valid manifest contributes.

patterns.description: kind=fileContent: the match vocabulary. Declared here so it is reviewable and correctable without a rebuild, and so it is never read from the scanned project.

broad.description: This fact also exists in repositories that are not this kind of project, so it must never be a pack's only satisfied leaf.

description.description: Why this fact is declared the way it is. Read by humans reviewing the vocabulary, never by the evaluator.

deferredTo.description: The requirement id that owns a fact declared here but not implemented in this phase. Declaring it keeps the near-miss line honest instead of silently omitting the pack's leaf.
